{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "She wants a look that stays streamlined and classic while standing in a crowded rock concert venue on a cool autumn evening, so the outfit must be elegant enough to handle artificial club lighting but durable enough for walking through crowds. The dress code is smart, meaning we need structured separates or a tailored silhouette rather than loose loungewear, and she explicitly refused anything too loud or messy given her preference for classic registers.

Structured wool-blend blazer, tailored fit, knee-length, charcoal grey, wool blend
Refined merino wool skirt, A-line cut, midi length, midnight blue, heavy jersey with a subtle ribbed texture
Silk-blend blouse, relaxed collar, hip-length, cream ivory, satin weave
Pointed-toe leather ankle boots, stiletto heel, knee-high shaft, black patent finish, smooth calfskin leather

This ensemble works because the structured blazer and tailored skirt instantly elevate the look to the requested smart formality level while keeping lines clean and classic as she moves through the venue. The neutral color palette of charcoal and cream ensures she remains visually cohesive under the flashing strobe lights without competing for attention, letting her outfit speak a language of refined restraint rather than rock-star excess. Finally, the sturdy ankle boots provide the necessary support for walking in a crowd, blending practicality with the polished finish expected at an evening social event."}
